overall_goal: Transfer baked cheese straws, wash utensils, and fill a jam jar with curd mixture.

goals.description: Check tart cases in the oven.
goals.rationale: The person turns off the oven alarm, puts on oven gloves, opens the oven, and checks the doneness of the tart cases.

goals.description: Transfer the first batch of cheese straws to a plate.
goals.rationale: The person uses a spatula to remove baked cheese straws from the baking tray and places them onto a plate.

goals.description: Transfer the remaining cheese straws to a plate and clear the area.
goals.rationale: The person finishes transferring the rest of the cheese straws to the plate and moves the plate and spatula out of the way.
The person stacks the empty baking trays and moves them near the sink to be washed later.
The person picks up a teaspoon, washes it under the tap, and dries it with a tea towel.

goals.description: Rearrange muffin trays and mixing bowl.
goals.rationale: The person checks the temperature of the muffin trays, uses an oven glove to move them, and repositions the mixing bowl.

goals.description: Get a tablespoon from the cutlery drawer.
goals.rationale: The person opens the cutlery drawer to retrieve a tablespoon for stirring the mixture.

goals.description: Prepare and stir the raspberry and lemon curd mixture.
goals.rationale: The person moves items out of the way, places the tablespoon into the mixing bowl, and stirs the curd mixture.

goals.description: Take a jam jar out of the oven.
goals.rationale: The person opens the oven door and uses an oven glove and pan gripper to safely remove a hot jam jar.

goals.description: Fill the jam jar with raspberry and lemon curd mixture.
goals.rationale: The person uses a teaspoon to scoop the curd mixture and carefully pours it into the hot jam jar.

goals.description: Secure the filled jam jar and put away tools.
goals.rationale: The person transfers the hot jam jar between hands using pan grippers and sets down the tools used.
